lines.text: 我来这里是要接我儿子回家的。可我发现，他已经在家里了。
lines.en: I came here to take my son home. And I realized he already is home.
lines.note: 中文采用 Reddit 中文讨论版译法，标注为对照译法（核证证据：https://en.wikiquote.org/wiki/Kramer_vs._Kramer（逐字："And I realized he already is home. Oh, I love him very much... I'm not gonna take him with me. Can I go up and talk to him?"）；https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0079417/quotes/（逐字："I came here to take my son home. And I realized he already is home."）；https://www.reddit.com/r/movies/comments/291m3h/what_are_the_best_most_memorable_monologues_by/（中文版逐字："我来这里是为了带我的儿子回家。然后我意识到，他已经在家里了。"））

lines.text: 医生：你没理由进去。／泰德：有理由。他是我儿子。你们要对他做什么，我都要陪着他。
lines.en: Doctor: There's no reason for you to be in there. / Ted: Yeah, there is. He's my son. If you're gonna do something to him, I'm going to be with him.
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译（比利脑伤医院场景）（核证证据：https://www.shmoop.com/study-guides/kramer-vs-kramer/family-quotes.html（逐字："DOCTOR: There's no reason for you to be in there. TED: Yeah, there is. He's my son. If you're gonna do something to him, I'm going to be with him."））

lines.text: 我要妈妈！／你现在只有我了。
lines.en: Billy: I want my mommy! / Ted: I'm all you got.
lines.character: 比利·克莱默 / 特德·克莱默
lines.note: 中文为对照翻译（乔安娜离家当晚父子场景）（核证证据：https://www.funtrivia.com（Great Movie Exchanges 测验逐字："I want my mommy!" "I'm all you got."，答案 Kramer vs. Kramer））
